multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.name: staggered-follow
multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.action: Participants A and C walk one behind the other along one side of the trail while participants B and D walk one behind the other along the other side, C ahead of A and D ahead of B, the two lines offset so that nobody moves directly abreast; everyone keeps the same steady pace.
multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: Everyone keeps walking forward at the same steady pace, holding their places in the two offset lines with the spacing unchanged.

multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.name: staggered-follow-continued
multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.action: Everyone keeps walking forward at the same steady pace, holding their places in the two offset lines with the spacing unchanged.
multi4-001-forest-staggered-follow.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: Everyone keeps walking forward at the same steady pace, holding their places in the two offset lines with the spacing unchanged.

multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.name: approach
multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.action: Participants A and B wade out of the shallow stream one behind the other, B ahead of A, and walk on along one lane while participants C and D walk the opposite way along a parallel lane, D ahead of C, so the two pairs close in on each other; B and D pass each other with lateral clearance near the end of this span.
multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: The pairs keep walking without stopping or turning and pass one another with lateral clearance - A and D and B and C at about the same moment, then A and C - while D steps down into the shallow stream as the pairs move apart.

multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.name: pass
multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.action: The pairs keep walking without stopping or turning and pass one another with lateral clearance - A and D and B and C at about the same moment, then A and C - while D steps down into the shallow stream as the pairs move apart.
multi4-002-jungle-opposing-pairs.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: The pairs keep walking without stopping or turning and pass one another with lateral clearance - A and D and B and C at about the same moment, then A and C - while D steps down into the shallow stream as the pairs move apart.

multi4-003-grassland-crossroads.name: approach

multi4-003-grassland-crossroads.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: They cross through the middle with clearance, A passing closest to D and B passing closest to C, and each keeps walking straight on along their own direction, moving apart.

multi4-003-grassland-crossroads.name: cross
multi4-003-grassland-crossroads.action: They cross through the middle with clearance, A passing closest to D and B passing closest to C, and each keeps walking straight on along their own direction, moving apart.
multi4-003-grassland-crossroads.outcome: at the end of the segment this has just happened or is happening: They cross through the middle with clearance, A passing closest to D and B passing closest to C, and each keeps walking straight on along their own direction, moving apart.
